pivHint: A FLAME is the glowing, flickering part of a fire. An old FLAME is a former ______.
winText: Still burning. FLAME was the pivot - a candle's glow to an old FLAME, a past LOVER.
lossText: LOVER - someone you have romantic feelings for. FLAME was the pivot: a FLAME is the glow atop a candle, but an old FLAME is a former sweetheart, a past LOVER.
